description: This file defines the AutoFilter class used within PhpSpreadsheet to handle auto-filtering of worksheet data ranges, including filtering criteria, row visibility, and range management.

classes.name: AutoFilter
classes.description: Class for managing autofiltering in a worksheet, including range, columns, filtering rules, and applying filters to show or hide rows.

methods.name: getEvaluated
methods.description: Returns whether the filter has been evaluated.

methods.name: setEvaluated
methods.description: Sets the evaluated status of the filter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an AutoFilter object with optional range and worksheet.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent worksheet.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent worksheet.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Returns the autofilter range.

methods.name: setRange
methods.description: Sets the autofilter range and adjusts columns accordingly.

methods.name: setRangeToMaxRow
methods.description: Extends the filter range to the worksheet's highest row.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns all columns with filters.

methods.name: testColumnInRange
methods.description: Validates and returns the offset of a column within the autofilter range.

methods.name: getColumnOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset of a column within the range.

methods.name: getColumn
methods.description: Returns a specific AutoFilter column object by column name.

methods.name: getColumnByOffset
methods.description: Retrieves a column object by its offset.

methods.name: setColumn
methods.description: Sets a column filter rule.

methods.name: clearColumn
methods.description: Removes a filter from a specified column.

methods.name: shiftColumn
methods.description: Shifts a column filter to a different column, bypassing validation.

methods.name: filterTestInSimpleDataSet
methods.description: Tests if a cell value exists within a simple data set filter.

methods.name: filterTestInDateGroupSet
methods.description: Tests if a date cell value is in a specified set of months.

methods.name: filterTestInCustomDataSet
methods.description: Tests if a cell value matches rules in a custom data set, including wildcards and operators.

methods.name: filterTestInPeriodDateSet
methods.description: Tests if a date value falls within a specified set of months.

methods.name: makeDateObject
methods.description: Creates a DateTime object for specified year, month, day, hour, minute, second.

methods.name: dynamicLastMonth
methods.description: Returns the date range for last month.

methods.name: firstDayOfQuarter
methods.description: Returns the first day of the current quarter.

methods.name: dynamicLastQuarter
methods.description: Returns the date range for the last quarter.

methods.name: dynamicLastWeek
methods.description: Returns the date range for the last week.

methods.name: dynamicLastYear
methods.description: Returns the date range for the last year.

methods.name: dynamicNextMonth
methods.description: Returns the date range for next month.

methods.name: dynamicNextQuarter
methods.description: Returns the date range for the next quarter.

methods.name: dynamicNextWeek
methods.description: Returns the date range for next week.

methods.name: dynamicNextYear
methods.description: Returns the date range for next year.

methods.name: dynamicThisMonth
methods.description: Returns the date range for the current month.

methods.name: dynamicThisQuarter
methods.description: Returns the date range for the current quarter.

methods.name: dynamicThisWeek
methods.description: Returns the date range for the current week.

methods.name: dynamicThisYear
methods.description: Returns the date range for the current year.

methods.name: dynamicToday
methods.description: Returns the date range for today.

methods.name: dynamicTomorrow
methods.description: Returns the date range for tomorrow.

methods.name: dynamicYearToDate
methods.description: Returns the date range from start of year to today.

methods.name: dynamicYesterday
methods.description: Returns the date range for yesterday.

methods.name: dynamicFilterDateRange
methods.description: Converts a dynamic filter rule into a date range for filtering.

methods.name: calculateTopTenValue
methods.description: Calculates the top N value in a column based on current data.

methods.name: showHideRows
methods.description: Applies filter rules to show or hide worksheet rows.

methods.name: autoExtendRange
methods.description: Auto-extends a range to include the first empty row following data.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of the AutoFilter object.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the range as a string.
